verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Brex has bill-pay/invoice approval automation (brex-docs-7), vendor payment sending via Payments API (brex-docs-12), and procurement approval flows for cards (brex-docs-15), implying approval workflows exist, but there is no direct documentation of configuring designated-teammate approval permissions or a one-click approve-and-send payment action for a finance-lead. Missing for 10: explicit docs on setting approval roles/permissions, evidence of a one-click approve-and-send UX, and independent confirmation this works as described.
